description:
it's almost harvesting season

Click on the Khuzait Khanate crest to download!

Been on a Bannerlord kick lately and this was one of the first things I thought of. Can't find the Nordvyg faction flag asset; if anyone has that lying around, let me know and I'll update this. This is also my first mod to support icons at launch!

Demonstration video:

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/xce4qXSY6B4
